---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new capability for Riptide
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem statement

What are you trying to accomplish that Riptide does not currently let you do? Concrete use cases beat abstract asks — if you can name a protocol or a failure mode that would exercise this feature, please include it.

## Proposed solution

How you'd like Riptide to work. If it fits inside the six-layer stack (new adapter, new persona, new taxonomy category, new scenario preset, new invariant shape), say which layer.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why you rejected them. If "just author it as a persona TOML" already works, it's useful to flag that and explain why the persona path isn't enough.

## Additional context

Links to protocols, incidents, academic work, or other simulators that do something similar. Screenshots welcome if you have a mental picture.
